notes: El puente ya funciona con USDT, DAI y WBTC, no solo con USDC. / The bridge now works with USDT, DAI and WBTC, not just USDC.

notes_i18n.es:
El puente solo funcionaba de verdad con USDC. Al elegir USDT, DAI o WBTC fallaba nada mas empezar con un error tecnico de direccion, y no habia forma de cruzarlos.
La causa eran tres direcciones de contrato mal escritas por nuestra parte. En Ethereum las mayusculas de una direccion no son decoracion: son su cifra de control, y la libreria rechazaba la operacion antes de intentarla.
Corregidas las tres. Las cuatro rutas del puente responden ya, y hemos anadido una comprobacion automatica para que no vuelva a colarse una direccion mal escrita.
notes_i18n.en:
The bridge only really worked with USDC. Picking USDT, DAI or WBTC failed right at the start with a technical address error, and there was no way to bridge them.
The cause was three contract addresses mistyped on our side. In Ethereum the capitalisation of an address is not decoration: it is its check digit, and the library refused the operation before even trying.
All three are fixed. The four bridge routes now respond, and we added an automatic check so a mistyped address cannot slip through again.
